findings.title: Future guest path runs the Go caller as root and cannot admit the required UID1001 client
findings.evidence: Root is required by run(). Controller root is created root:root 0700; ControlServer creates root-owned 0600 control.sock; peer_uid is os.getuid()==0; Runner.Popen supplies no user/group/extra_groups override. Thus the current caller is UID0. A genuine UID1001/GID1002 caller cannot search the root, cannot write the socket, and would also fail SO_PEERCRED even after those DAC obstacles were independently corrected. Existing same-current-UID unit positives cannot qualify this boundary.
findings.reproducer: review_probes.py records exact Linux DAC mode/owner evaluation without changing UID. Source inspection confirms all three obstacles and inherited caller UID. No claim of an actual UID1001/root execution test is made.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep privileged phase/controller files root-owned 0700. Provide a separate fresh caller-accessible, root-controlled UDS directory, with explicit traversal policy, socket chowned1001:1002 mode0600 and server peer_uid1001. Actually launch caller with user1001/group1002/empty supplementary groups and an accessible safe cwd/executable ancestry; keep key stdin-only. Do not merely chown the socket or weaken the whole controller root. Add separate denied-UID/path tests and require the real guest UID1001 positive before admission.

findings.title: Current admission verifies self-consistency, not independently established authority or an exact reviewed code tuple
findings.evidence: The live validator accepts a whitespace-rehashed old653 manifest as a new source, a deliberately non-executable arbitrary helper with a different hash, made-up parent/code-review handle strings, and a matching made-up preflight object. review_probes.json records accepted_by_current_validator:true. Old-ID inequality is not new proxy654 identity validation. The guard implementation itself is an external selected executable: comparing its JSON return to expected values does not establish that it actually read provider/controller/default-daemon state. No actual qualifying guard source/current parent authority was provided to this review.
findings.trust_boundary: This is not a claim of HMAC bypass or remote root compromise. A genuinely trusted parent can enforce authority outside this component; untrusted JSON and unit-test fabricated reports cannot. The standalone --live path currently has no independently established parent allowlist or trusted-input provenance check, so its successful validate() is not evidence of approval.
findings.minimal_fix: Bind execution to the concrete independently reviewed parent-installed manifest/helper/orchestrator/caller/guard/fixture tuple and actual review handles under protected parent-owned ancestry. Parent must derive scoped lease/reports from standing authority and inspect the real pinned guard implementation for fresh provider/controller/default-daemon readbacks. Use the reviewed combined bundle identity recorded here; do not treat STAGED_NOT_APPROVED or arbitrary nonempty strings as admission. No new signing system or broad architecture is necessary.

findings.title: Pinned leaf checks do not protect source/executable ancestry or later pathname execution
findings.evidence: pinned() rejects symlink ancestors and group/other-writable leaves, but never checks ancestor owner/mode or leaf owner. A private0600 leaf inside a0777 ancestor is accepted by the real function (review-probes.json). It closes the descriptor after hashing, while caller and guard are later executed by path. An untrusted writable ancestor permits replacement after review/hash verification. resolve() on own dependency paths also erases evidence of a symlinked original ancestry. Fresh root.mkdir under trusted /run is exclusive and fine; that does not secure arbitrary config/source/caller/guard paths.
findings.minimal_fix: Require trusted owner/non-worker-writable ancestors and trusted leaf owners for parent config, snapshots, review objects and executables; retain and consume verified source/executable objects where applicable, or execute only from an independently protected immutable staging tree. Validate the config itself before pathname execution. Test an ancestor rename/replacement between pin and consumption; do not rely only on leaf mode/hash.

findings.title: Quota canary deletes a pre-existing file when exclusive filler creation fails
findings.evidence: names.append(name) precedes open(name,'xb'). If canary-fill-00 already exists, EEXIST fails the probe but finally unlinks that existing non-owned file. Executing the exact literal with only /work substituted for an owned local fixture reproduced AssertionError plus preexisting_file_deleted:true without allocating fillers.
findings.minimal_fix: Add a name to the cleanup-owned set only after successful exclusive creation; preferably retain opened object identity and refuse replacement on unlink. Preserve the original failure while attempting cleanup of every successfully created filler. Add the collision negative test without weakening assertions.

reviewed_controls_and_limits: Dedicated fresh /run/artex-canary-12hex directory creation is exclusive; phase sentinel rejects a second actual Python process before image build/Docker and preserves persistent marker/counters. No claimed crash restart recovery is implemented.

Root-controlled Docker endpoint constant, socket UID/device/inode, daemon ID/root and initial exact9containers/44images/4volumes are compared before mutation. Final inventory preserves exact container/volume IDs and all original image IDs, permitting only the newly derived helper image; no prune or old-resource deletion.

Mount target is exact root/data with64MiB tmpfs uid1001/gid1002 mode0700 nodev/nosuid/noexec. Retained WorkspaceQuota FD binds dev/inode/capacity and rechecks before archive; work/work-output/fixture originate on that filesystem. Only /work RW and /fixture RO binds plus exact bounded tmpfs shadows are admitted; Config.Volumes must exactly equal /app/data. Private app/key/controller/target state are not helper mounts.

Target drops supplementary groups/GID/UID to1002/1001 before exec of already reviewed fixture bytes. Its separate /run/artex-target-nonce state directory is chowned1001:1002 0700 and file handling uses exclusive/no-follow private files. It does not chdir or close all inherited controller/quota FDs after fork: explicitly chdir to state and close non-required inherited FDs during correction, and verify real guest private-path startup. No target listener was started by reviewer.

Shared phase reserves create attempts and every correct-peer gateway request before method/origin rejection. Planned25effects+7HTTP fits32; accepted/rejected requests do not reset counters. ScopeBudget cancellation is local; second output scope shares the same Phase/Broker quota. No fake whole-phase cancellation is credited as second-scope continuation.

Inflight revocation is conditioned on observed runtime and payload-guard entry, then requires caller thread settlement, exact removal/ps absence, init PID namespace difference and empty owned cgroup before postcancel denial. Source swap hooks execute after host pins but before actual create and require mounted-object mismatch, zero ACK guard entries and no marker. These are future real Docker paths, not exercised here.

Observed runtime checks use Docker inspect plus /proc UID/GID/caps/nnp/namespaces/cgroup limits rather than dataclass claims. H2 uses typed equality against actual helper fstat/statfs identities. Several outer admission fields still use ordinary Python equality (e.g.schema True equals1/socket UID False equals0); tighten their numeric/boolean type checks rather than claiming all JSON is strictly typed.

Runner bounds commands/output/deadlines and kills/waits its caller process group. Broker uses independent uncancelled exact-name removal plus absence query on success and failure and retains quarantine/lock/FDs if unresolved. Orchestrator attempts component shutdown and inventory readback; archive/unmount occurs only if safe. Errors remain FAILED, not COMPLETE. Absolute original provider STOP remains external and must not be extended.

Archive accepts ordinary single-link files only, checksums every member, caps archive bytes, fsyncs and reads back before exact umount/mountinfo absence. It uses path-based traversal/read after lstat, not pinned leaf FDs: after F1 ancestry changes, maintain the no-writer settlement invariant and harden against path replacement rather than treating quota-root identity alone as archive leaf pinning.

COMPLETE is gated on all executed normal/swap/inflight/output/restart cases plus successful service settlement, inventory/archive/unmount observations. No current receipt satisfies these real-guest gates; no RuntimeModel HTTP or model/native target operations were performed.
